verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can export content at any time, export all channels, and choose Markdown as the export format, so the archive can leave the app in an open format. Everything else stays inside an encrypted vault on the device. The alternative export format, Any-Block, is not documented as open or JSON in this evidence. missing for 10: an explicitly documented JSON or open-spec export (Any-Block's format is not described), evidence of how much structure (properties, relations, Types) survives Markdown export, independent or hands-on corroboration of export fidelity.
